en.headline: Two more mpox cases confirmed, CHP urges high-risk groups to vaccinate
en.dek: A 28-year-old and a 26-year-old man are in isolation after high-risk sexual contacts in Hong Kong; 16 cases have been recorded since August.
body: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating two further confirmed mpox cases and has again urged people who engage in high-risk sexual contact to seek vaccination and take precautions.

The first patient is a 28-year-old man who developed a generalised rash, including on the genital area, forearm, abdomen and face, from 9 September. He attended a social hygiene clinic on 15 September and was admitted to Princess Margaret Hospital for isolation. The second patient, aged 26, developed fever, sore throat, muscle pain, fatigue and swollen lymph nodes from 30 August, followed by a rash on the genitals, chest and limbs. He sought medical attention on 8 and 15 September and is isolated at Queen Elizabeth Hospital. Both are in stable condition.

Epidemiological investigations found both men reported high-risk sexual contact with other men in Hong Kong during the incubation period. No links have been identified between the two cases or with earlier ones. Since August, Hong Kong has recorded 16 new mpox cases; the yearly total now stands at 25, of which 20 are local. Ten of the recent patients reported using dating apps to find partners.

The centre is contacting people who may have had high-risk exposure and has notified the World Health Organization. It continues to advise high-risk groups to receive mpox vaccination and to avoid close physical contact with anyone suspected of infection.

zh.headline: 再增兩宗猴痘確診 防護中心籲高風險群組接種疫苗
zh.dek: 28歲及26歲男子分別因高風險性行為感染，現於醫院隔離治療；八月至今累計16宗新個案。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心今日公布正調查兩宗新增猴痘確診個案，並再次呼籲有高風險性接觸的人士接種疫苗及做好防護。
首宗個案涉及一名28歲男子，他自9月9日起身體多處出現皮疹，包括生殖器官、前臂、腹部及面部。他於9月15日到社會衞生科診所求診，其後被安排到瑪嘉烈醫院接受隔離治療。第二宗個案涉及一名26歲男子，他於8月30日出現發燒、喉嚨痛、肌肉痛、疲倦及淋巴結腫大，其後生殖器官、胸口及四肢陸續出現皮疹。他曾於9月8日及15日求醫，現於伊利沙伯醫院隔離，兩人情況穩定。
流行病學調查顯示，兩名患者於潛伏期內均在香港與其他男子有高風險接觸。個案之間及與本港早前個案暫時未發現流行病學關連。自八月起本港錄得16宗新猴痘個案，本年累計25宗，其中20宗為本地個案。近期個案中有10人報稱使用交友應用程式尋找性伴侶。
防護中心正設法聯繫曾有高風險接觸的人士，並已將個案通報世界衞生組織。中心繼續建議高風險目標群組接種猴痘疫苗，並避免與懷疑感染者作密切身體接觸。
